title: PHP Developer
description: Revpanda is looking for a hands-on PHP Developer to join our development team and work across several web projects. In this role, you’ll be responsible for both back-end development and front-end implementation, working with existing codebases built primarily with Yii2 and Laravel. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable getting into unfamiliar code, understanding how things work, and quickly becoming productive. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of features and improvements from development through to delivery, while contributing to the performance, security, and overall quality of our web projects. Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and improve multiple web projects built with PHP, primarily using Yii2 and Laravel. Work across existing codebases, quickly understand unfamiliar architecture and business logic, and become productive with minimal guidance. Develop and maintain back-end functionality, APIs, integrations, business logic, and database interactions. Design, optimise, and maintain MySQL databases, including schemas, queries, indexes, and data relationships. Identify and resolve performance issues, including slow database queries and application bottlenecks. Implement front-end functionality independently, converting Figma designs into clean, responsive, and cross-browser web pages. Ensure high attention to detail when implementing designs, including spacing, typography, layouts, responsiveness, and UI behaviour. Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and UI frameworks such as Bootstrap or Tailwind. Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code while following established coding standards and project conventions. Use Git effectively, including working with branches, keeping commits focused, and participating in code reviews. Identify and address common web security risks, including SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, insecure file uploads, and access-control issues. Troubleshoot bugs and production issues, investigate root causes, and implement reliable fixes. Take ownership of assigned tasks from understanding requirements through development, testing, deployment, and follow-up. Work independently across several projects, prioritising tasks and switching between different codebases and contexts while maintaining quality. Collaborate with other developers, designers, SEO specialists, and business stakeholders when required. Contribute to continuous improvements in code quality, application performance, development processes, and overall project stability. Apply technical SEO and page-speed best practices where relevant to the projects. Maintain and improve existing infrastructure and development workflows, including Docker, Linux/nginx, Redis, queues, and automated testing where applicable. Requirements: 3+ years of professional PHP experience. Confident in at least one modern PHP MVC framework (Yii2 or Laravel is a plus) and able to pick up others quickly. Strong MySQL: schema design, indexing, joins, and the ability to diagnose a slow query. Solid front-end skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (vanilla or jQuery), Bootstrap or Tailwind - able to build a clean, responsive, cross-browser page from a Figma file with attention to spacing, typography and detail. Git discipline: small commits, branches, code review. Security fundamentals: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, file uploads, access control. Able to work independently across multiple projects and switch context without losing quality. What we offer: Diverse career growth opportunities. Friendly and supportive colleagues. Highly competitive compensation and performance bonuses. Attractive “Refer a Friend” bonus program. Fully remote work opportunity. Advanced benefits package (public holidays, annual vacations, covered sick leave, additional days off, etc). Paid trainings and work-related courses. Mental health support (psychological sessions, coaching, therapy). Monthly virtual teambuilding's to stay connected and engaged.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Loodos is one of the first established companies in the industry, providing end-to-end mobile solutions since 2004. Who we are: Loodos’s utmost motivation is Mobile Excellence. We build end-to-end solutions with best technical and business approaches. Bringing human behavior understanding and deep technical abilities together carry the mobile application to level of excellence. In our R&D center office we have awesome teammates that we can safely incorporate into our mobile application and infrastructure projects, which have a direct R&D-oriented vision and reach over 25 million monthly active users. Excellence is not only a station to arrive, but also a way of journey! We open our doors to every method and idea that will help our self-development. We are a team that ‘loves their job’, ‘builds strong infrastructures’, ‘high-tech oriented employees’ and ‘always entertained’. If you want to be a part of the beloved culture of Loodos, your place is ready! Would you like to join us? What we’re looking for: 3+ years of experience with deep skills in development Good verbal and written communication skills (in Turkish and English – min B1 level) Solid understanding of the software development life cycle Ability to write testable, clean and high-quality code Familiar with common development and Agile practices Knowledge of multiple languages and frameworks (.NET, Java, JavaScript, Typescript etc.) Experience in front-end web development with some combination of React.js, Vue.js and/or Angular Good knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, nginx, gRPC, RabbitMQ/Kafka, ElasticAPM, Grafana, Ocelot Experience with Redis, ElasticSearch and/or MongoDB Deep understanding of third-party libraries, web services and REST APIs Strong knowledge of design principles, patterns, and best practices Hands-on experience developing production-ready mobile and web applications Experience in tools for effective teamwork such as Git, Issue Tracking, CI/CD Being passionate to use new technologies in projects Ability to quickly learn and unlearn Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines Strong communication, problem solving and critical and analytical thinking skills What you’ll do: We are looking for new teammates who will contribute to building scalable, high-quality web and mobile applications across the full stack. As a Full Stack Developer, you will design and develop both front-end and back-end systems used by millions of users, taking an active role in technical decisions and ensuring sustainable, efficient solutions. You will collaborate closely with product and technical teams, identify architectural challenges early, and take initiative to solve them. By continuously improving existing systems from UI components to backend services and infrastructure and exploring better ways of building digital experiences, you will contribute directly to both development processes and product quality. What’s in it for you? Being a part of a fast growing and R&D focused tech company and working witha young, talented, and dynamic team Great career and personal development opportunities in a project-based working environment Unique opportunity to take responsibility in active local and/or worldwide projects from different industries Within a flat organization structure, open communication in the workplace Flexible working hours, locations (not only during the pandemic) Net salary, meal card, private health insurance for sure Personal training budget ($ 1000 / year) Happy hours, team-bonding events A pleasant, beloved, and activity-filled office To get to know us better, please have a look at our website! https://loodos.com/ We believe in diversity and equal opportunity! All applications will be assessed regardless to age, religion, gender identity, race, nationality, disability, or marital status. Note: We’ll contact only with suitable applicants. Thanks in advance for your understanding!

title: SAP Integration & Full Stack Developer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP Integration & Full Stack Developer based in Turkey. This is a fully remote contract opportunity for a developer who can bridge SAP integration, APIs, backend services, frontend applications, and third-party enterprise platforms. You will design and deliver end-to-end solutions connecting SAP, Zoho, and other business systems across diverse technical environments. The role combines hands-on development with integration architecture, data transformation, API security, troubleshooting, and production support. You will work with technologies including SAP Integration Suite (CPI), SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, and modern frontend frameworks. A key part of the role is determining the right integration approach for both API-enabled and legacy systems, including file-based, SFTP, webhook, and database integrations. You will collaborate with technical, functional, and business stakeholders while helping strengthen internal capabilities through documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer. This position is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys solving complex integration challenges and building reliable applications across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems. Accountabilities SAP Integration Development: Develop, configure, maintain, test, and monitor integrations using SAP Integration Suite (SAP Cloud Integration/CPI), connecting SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Zoho, and other enterprise applications. API Development & Management: Design, develop, consume, and maintain REST and SOAP APIs while applying sound principles of API architecture, lifecycle management, security, authentication, authorization, and monitoring. Full-Stack Development: Build and maintain backend services, APIs, frontend applications, and supporting components using technologies such as Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, React, Angular, or SAP UI5. Enterprise Integration: Create reliable integrations between SAP, Zoho CRM, other Zoho applications, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, middleware, and other appropriate technologies. Non-API Integrations: Develop alternative integration solutions for systems without standard APIs, including SFTP, file-based exchanges, scheduled data transfers, database connectivity, webhooks, and other suitable approaches. Integration Architecture: Evaluate business and technical requirements and select appropriate integration patterns based on system capabilities, limitations, security considerations, data requirements, and overall architecture. Data Transformation: Work with JSON, XML, OData, HTTP, REST, SOAP, and related protocols and formats, implementing mapping, transformation, routing, filtering, validation, and error-handling processes. Security: Implement and maintain secure integration solutions using OAuth 2.0, certificates, authentication, authorization, and other API and enterprise security mechanisms. Testing & Production Support: Develop, test, debug, deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot integration flows, APIs, and application services while performing root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions. Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate business processes and improve connectivity between SAP, Zoho, and other enterprise applications. Collaboration: Work closely with SAP functional teams, developers, architects, business stakeholders, and external technology teams to understand requirements and deliver effective technical solutions. Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation covering integration architecture, configurations, interfaces, workflows, troubleshooting procedures, deployment processes, and support guidelines. Code Quality: Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment activities, monitoring, and production support while following development and integration best practices. Knowledge Transfer: Train and mentor internal team members on SAP Integration Suite, APIs, integration patterns, troubleshooting, monitoring, development practices, and long-term maintenance. Capability Building: Help internal teams develop the skills and confidence required to independently maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance integrations and applications. Requirements Professional Experience: 3–6 years of relevant experience in IT development, software engineering, integration, or a related field. SAP Integration: Strong hands-on experience with SAP Integration Suite / SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), including the development and maintenance of integration flows. API Expertise: Strong understanding of REST, SOAP, API development, API integration, API architecture, lifecycle management, and API security. SAP Ecosystem: Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP and non-SAP applications; familiarity with SAP BTP is an advantage. Programming: Strong programming skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, or Java, together with a solid understanding of full-stack development concepts. Frontend Development: Experience with React, Angular, or SAP UI5 is desirable. Data & Protocols: Strong knowledge of JSON, XML, OData, HTTP, data transformation, data mapping, and enterprise integration formats. Security: Practical understanding of authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, certificates, and API security principles. Development Practices: Experience with Git, version control, CI/CD processes, testing, deployment, and production support. Cloud Architecture: Understanding of cloud-based application and enterprise integration architectures; experience with Azure, AWS, or another cloud platform is a plus. Troubleshooting: Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to investigate complex integration and application issues and identify sustainable solutions. Enterprise Integration: Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and best practices, with the ability to select appropriate approaches for both API-enabled and non-API systems. Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration: Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with developers, architects, functional teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners. Knowledge Sharing: Willingness to document solutions, mentor colleagues, provide technical training, and contribute to long-term internal technical capabilities. Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Additional Experience: Experience with SAP API Management, SAP Event Mesh, event-driven architectures, SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP), SAP Fiori/SAP UI5, third-party cloud integrations, Zoho CRM, webhooks, SFTP, database integrations, or scheduled data exchanges is an advantage. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Competitive contract compensation package. Remote Work: Flexible working conditions with the ability to work remotely. Professional Development: Opportunities to expand expertise across SAP, AI, cloud technologies, enterprise integration, APIs, and modern application development. End-to-End Ownership: Opportunity to contribute to complete integration and application development projects spanning frontend applications, APIs, integration layers, and enterprise systems. Technology Exposure: Hands-on experience with SAP Integration Suite, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Zoho, cloud platforms, APIs, and modern development technologies. Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and advancement through increasingly complex technical responsibilities. Collaborative Environment: Work alongside technical, functional, architecture, and business teams in a dynamic and supportive environment. Knowledge Sharing: Opportunity to develop leadership skills through mentoring, technical training, documentation, and knowledge-transfer initiatives. title: Senior Frontend Developer (React & React Native)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Frontend Developer (React & React Native) based in Turkey. This role is an opportunity for an experienced frontend engineer to build and evolve modern web and mobile experiences using React and React Native. You will contribute to stable, long-term projects with an active pipeline of new front-office features and continuous technical improvements. Your work will span user interface development, code refactoring, performance optimization, testing, and cross-platform mobile development. You will help translate business requirements into robust technical solutions while ensuring applications remain scalable, maintainable, and performant. The position combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across teams and requires strong ownership in a dynamic environment. You will have the opportunity to improve existing products while introducing new technologies, patterns, and development practices. This is a strong fit for a proactive senior engineer who enjoys solving complex frontend challenges and continuously expanding their technical expertise. Accountabilities Assess business requirements from a technical perspective and determine practical implementation approaches within reasonable timelines. Develop new user interface components and enhance existing web applications using modern React and TypeScript patterns. Build and maintain responsive, high-quality websites and front-office features. Participate in mobile application development using React Native, including cross-platform solutions and reusable software development kits (SDKs). Refactor and optimize existing code to improve maintainability, scalability, and overall application quality. Optimize frontend components and applications for strong performance across different browsers and devices. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs across existing projects and production environments. Work with state management solutions such as Redux, MobX, or Zustand to create reliable and maintainable application architectures. Integrate and work with RESTful and GraphQL APIs as part of frontend and mobile application development. Implement and maintain automated tests using tools such as Jest and Cypress. Contribute to frontend build processes, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and modern development workflows. Collaborate proactively with team members and communicate technical considerations, progress, challenges, and solutions clearly. Knowledge of design systems and technologies such as Material UI, Tailwind, or similar frameworks is a plus. Exposure to WebAssembly, WebSockets, or real-time applications is a plus. Experience integrating third-party tools and libraries is a plus. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into clear, practical technical requirements. Strong adaptability and ability to remain effective when priorities change. Proactive communication style, strong ownership, and willingness to take initiative.
